theorems.name: Submission.cmc_fc_sc_current_of_coeff_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (L : TestFormOn U n →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (A : ℝ), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn U n) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ≤ c) → |L ω| ≤ c * A) → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Y ω = L ω
